summary: Millions attended the funeral of Iran's late leader in Tehran, with US-Iran negotiations set to resume in Pakistan on July 11th. IDF reported eliminating a Hezbollah militant in southern Lebanon. The US paused airstrikes during the mourning period to allow Iran's leadership transition.
key_points: Millions of mourners gathered in Tehran's Grand Mosalla for the funeral of Ayatollah Khamenei, with estimates of 4 million using the metro system alone. (Source: @presstv/196968) Millions attended the mourning ceremony in Tehran, with the metro recording over 4 million passengers between 9am and 9pm. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374482) Hundreds of thousands of people participated in the mourning procession in Tehran, with the city's population estimated at 13 million. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/74719) The event showcased Iran's ability to mobilize large crowds despite previous US-Israeli attempts to undermine the revolution. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374478) A drone light show with 2,000 drones was held in Tehran's sky during the mourning ceremonies. (Source: @SharghDaily/169867) Foreign delegations from over 120 countries attended the funeral in Tehran. (Source: @pkpoi/143129) The funeral procession highlighted the deep popular support for Iran's leadership despite decades of conflict with the West. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374478)

US-Iran negotiations are scheduled to resume in Islamabad, Pakistan on July 11th, focusing on sanctions, frozen Iranian assets, and the nuclear program. (Source: @New_security8200/202218) The talks were paused for a week to allow Iran's leadership transition following the death of Ayatollah Khamenei. (Source: @VahidOnline/76787) US President Donald Trump stated the US could target Iranian officials present at the funeral but chose not to for negotiation purposes. (Source: @VahidOnline/76787) Trump emphasized the US is seeking a new framework in the region and will not join any political faction. (Source: @amitsegal/62746)

IDF eliminated a Hezbollah militant in southern Lebanon near the security zone of Brigade 551 and Division 91, following a pursuit operation. (Source: @idf_telegram/24522) The militant was identified as armed in the Majdal Shams area in southern Lebanon, and was neutralized after IDF forces opened fire and conducted extensive searches. (Source: @idf_telegram/24522) The IDF stated it will continue operations to remove threats and prevent Hezbollah from attacking Israeli citizens. (Source: @idf_telegram/24522)

Iran's air defense systems activated over Tehran during military drills by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, with reports of N.M. gunfire. (Source: @pkpoi/143137) The drills were part of broader efforts to demonstrate Iran's military readiness amid regional tensions. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/374483)

Reports indicate the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine-General Command met with Iran's Foreign Minister in Tehran. (Source: @presstv/196953) The meeting focused on regional resistance movements and coordination against Israeli occupation. (Source: @presstv/196953)

A report claims the US-Israeli bombing of an elementary school in Minab resulted in children's deaths, with families transporting the bodies to Tehran for mourning. (Source: @presstv/196970) The incident highlights ongoing civilian casualties in Gaza-related conflicts. (Source: @presstv/196970)

The 'Board of Peace' may declare Hamas in breach of the Gaza agreement within 2-3 months, potentially allowing Israel wider operational freedom in Hamas-held areas. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4594) This could lead to renewed fighting in Gaza. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4594)

sections.threat_assessment: The death of Iran's late leader and the subsequent mourning period have created a temporary pause in hostilities, with US-Iran negotiations set to resume in Pakistan on July 11th. IDF operations in southern Lebanon indicate ongoing tensions with Hezbollah, while the potential declaration of Hamas breaching the Gaza agreement could lead to renewed conflict. Iran's military drills and air defense activations demonstrate readiness amid regional instability, with internal power struggles among military camps seeking to influence the new leadership.
sections.regional_response: The US has temporarily paused airstrikes to allow Iran's leadership transition, with President Trump emphasizing a new political framework in the region. International delegations from over 120 countries attended the funeral in Tehran, highlighting global diplomatic engagement. The UAE's participation in the mourning ceremony indicates continued regional diplomacy despite tensions. Kurdish attacks in Iraq and Turkish military operations suggest ongoing instability in the northern regions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The large-scale mourning events in Tehran demonstrate significant popular support for Iran's leadership, potentially complicating future negotiations. The IDF's operations in southern Lebanon and the potential Hamas breach assessment suggest escalating tensions in Gaza and Lebanon. Iran's military drills and air defense activations indicate heightened readiness, while internal power struggles among military camps may lead to further instability. The US-Iran negotiations in Pakistan will be critical in determining future regional dynamics.
